sign4all.title: Sign4All → SignAI
sign4all.description: A speech-to-Colombian Sign Language (LSC) translator prototype built in a 3-person team: a cross-platform Flutter app with a FastAPI backend, an STT (Whisper) + NLP (spaCy) pipeline, and a 3D avatar (Blender, Manny UE5) built on an initial 10-sign corpus. Winner of Red Bull Basement Colombia 2026 among 1,000+ ideas; team finished top 8 at the international final in San Francisco, with 40+ countries competing. Development continues under the SignAI repository.

svmClassifier.title: Elite Player Classifier (SVM)
svmClassifier.description: An independently developed SVM classifier (scikit-learn) to distinguish "elite" vs. "standard" players from 6 performance variables, comparing linear and RBF kernels. Hyperparameters tuned with GridSearchCV and 5-fold cross-validation, evaluated with a confusion matrix and ROC/AUC curve.

distributedLibrary.title: Distributed Library Management System
distributedLibrary.description: A distributed book lending/return system built in a 4-person team using gRPC and Protocol Buffers, documented with UML component and sequence diagrams. A containerized Flask app deployed on a local Kubernetes cluster, configuring autoscaling, rolling updates, and self-healing.

extraEditable.title: Extra Editable
extraEditable.description: A real-time collaborative code editing platform built with a 7-person team, integrating Hocuspocus/Yjs for concurrent synchronization over an Angular editor with a Django REST Framework backend. An Nginx load-balancing gateway for 3 replicated instances, deployed with Docker and Ansible across 6 VMs, with JWT authentication and an LSP service for autocompletion.

omarchyPowerMenu.title: Omarchy Power Menu
omarchyPowerMenu.description: A published plugin for the Omarchy Linux desktop: a single bar button that opens a keyboard-navigable session menu with screensaver, lock, suspend, hibernate, log out, reboot, and shut down actions.

spotlight.heading: Winner, Red Bull Basement Colombia 2026
spotlight.story: Sign4All, a prototype that translates speech into Colombian Sign Language (LSC), won Red Bull Basement Colombia 2026 among more than 1,000 submitted ideas. The project went on to represent Colombia at the international final in San Francisco, finishing in the top 8 out of teams from over 40 countries. Development continues today under SignAI.
